personas.mission: Translates marketing concept briefs into compliant liquid formulas and packaging structures, ensuring regulatory limit adherence, pilot plant reproducibility, and strict unit Bill of Materials (BOM) target economics.

as_is.body: Liquid recipes kept in Word documents on local shared drives; packaging specs created separately in Specright PLM Lite; zero real-time link to Finance BOM costing models.

to_be.body: Single studio record connects liquid recipe and packaging dimensions. Live Bill of Materials (BOM) calculator verifies unit cost against target gross margin hurdles automatically.
